provenance.control_step: set_qpos, set_dofs_velocity, control_dofs_position(ctrl) on the actuated dofs, one scene.step() of `substeps` substeps

model.importer: gs.morphs.MJCF(file=<MJCF string>) of the problem's compiled model (mjcf_from_model)
model.edit: contype = conaffinity = 1 on the robot geoms, no <pair> block: Genesis does not read <pair> and imports contype = conaffinity = 0 geoms as visual only
model.kept: bodies, inertials, free and hinge joints (limits, armature), the general / affine actuators as the PD controller's kp = gainprm[0], kv = -biasprm[2], force limits from the joints' actuatorfrcrange, geom friction, solimp

dropped.pair_condim1_note: these pairs are frictionless in MuJoCo and frictional in Genesis
dropped.options: the MJCF <option> (Genesis takes the time step and the solver from SimOptions / RigidOptions, set from the problem)

dr.friction: set_friction_ratio per world on the floor link and the sole links: floor-sole contact friction = max(floor x r_floor, sole x r_sole) = the corpus friction exactly
dr.side_effect: in those worlds the sole capsules' contacts with other robot geoms use the scaled sole friction (sole-sole: min(f, sole) or f instead of sole; sole-other: f instead of the larger geom friction when f > floor friction)
dr.com: set_links_COM per world: body_ipos0[torso] + com (RigidOptions(batch_links_info=True)); Genesis recomputes its inverse weights from the shifted COM

deviations: model: robot geoms contype = conaffinity = 1 and no <pair> block (Genesis reads no <pair>); Genesis's default collision filter gives the same 502 pairs (provenance model.pair_check)
condim: 154 condim-1 (frictionless) pairs are frictional in Genesis (no per-contact condim)
solref: Genesis's constraint_timeconst = 0.02 (the model's solref) instead of a per-geom solref (Genesis drops an MJCF default solref in favour of its own time constant)
no qacc warm start input (cold constraint solve at every control step)
tolerance 1e-08 passed to Genesis as is (float32)
contact generation: Genesis's (multi-contact, contact_pruning_tolerance 0.02; MPR in the forward scene, GJK in the differentiable one), inverse weights recomputed by Genesis
gradient: integrator approximate_implicitfast (the only one Genesis differentiates), w.r.t. the initial qvel only

DR: foot friction through per-world friction ratios on the floor and sole links (956 worlds above the floor friction, 1337 below the sole friction get scaled sole friction on their sole-robot contacts too); COM through set_links_COM
provenance.compile: Genesis compiles its kernels on first use (scene.build runs one step); its kernel cache (the quadrants offline cache) makes later processes faster
